title: 第56章 钢铁城的传闻第55章海岸的难民
lines: 死寂锁死整片滩涂，海风彻底停滞，浑浊空气结块压实、重重覆压在龟裂的黑褐地表之上，辐射焦糊、死水霉腥、陈旧铁腐的混杂恶浊气息无一丝流转，死死黏附在肌肤纹路与破损衣料深处，每一次呼吸都带着气管磨砂般的干涩钝痛。耳膜持续低频空鸣，吞噬所有细碎动静，天地沦为一片灰度均质的死寂囚笼。无数难民佝偻凝滞的身形、空洞无光的眼眸、枯槁脱形的躯体，与崩塌断裂的废墟残垣彻底相融，构成西大陆最原始、最残酷、无半分生机的乱世底色。钢铁城三字落定，无风声异动、无声响起伏，唯有整片海岸浮动的暴戾气场骤然沉坠下沉，无形威压穿透衣料肌理，死死箍紧胸腔与神经，催生出持续性的皮肉发紧、心神发寒的生理性窒息感。
中年难民垂首僵立，躯体细碎震颤未曾停歇。自他吐出钢铁城名号的瞬间，呼吸便被迫浅促克制，胸腔起伏刻意压到极致微弱。在这片被强权阴影彻底笼罩的死地，提及霸主之名本身即是禁忌，经年累月的屠戮与清剿，让恐惧早已穿透皮肉、扎根骨血，成为无需恐吓、无需提醒的本能应激反应，仅一个名号，便足以碾碎底层流民仅剩的微薄底气。

陆寻双脚稳立滩涂，肩背肌群全程僵硬锁死，无丝毫松弛余地。掌心浸透湿气的纱布紧绷发硬，静态气压持续压迫创口，绵长的钝涩痛感顺着小臂肌理持续蔓延、反复拉扯。胸口十字徽章低频钝灼，皮肉发麻的区域不断扩张，从胸腔蔓延至脖颈、下颌，表层皮肤持续发烫发沉，是近距离直面西陆祸源核心紊乱能量的真实体感。他眼底沉黑无半分光亮，摒除所有杂念、剥离所有情绪，无唏嘘、无凝重、无波澜，仅以最审慎的求生姿态收纳环境信息、推演局势走向，呼吸匀冷刻板，恒定节律从未被周遭死寂压抑的氛围打乱分毫。

他精准捕捉难民身上所有外露的生理破绽：肩颈下意识收缩紧绷、膝盖不受控细微打颤、眼眸始终低垂不敢平视、呼吸节律持续紊乱失衡。每一处细碎失态，都是长期极致恐惧打磨出的本能反应，直观印证着钢铁城的残暴绝非虚妄传闻，而是碾压全域、根植人心的绝对威慑。东大陆的势力博弈尚有底线，厮杀征伐存有尺度与制衡，而西大陆秩序彻底崩塌，弱肉强食的原始杀伐成为唯一规则，钢铁城便是这套残酷规则的终极掌控者，无底线、无制衡、无余地。
“城主，什么来路。”
字句切碎、短促硬冷，无修饰、无助词、无情绪铺垫，在死寂空域中精准炸开，刺破静态留白。纯粹取证，不共情苦难、不感慨乱世、不滋生怜悯，只为抓取支撑前路决策的核心情报，所有思绪皆服务于生存与破局。
中年难民喉头反复干涩滚动，受损的声带难以发力，良久才挤出破碎沙哑的气音：“没人知道……真正的来路。”
“有人说，他是旧时代残存的改造人。”
“有人说，他是辐射变异后诞生的异类。”
“还有人说，他是这片腐烂死地滋生的杀伐凶煞。”
三类传闻零散破碎、无从考证，无史料记载、无亲眼佐证，尽数是底层流民在无尽屠戮与逃亡中，被极致恐惧催生的臆测与传言。经年血泪渲染、无数死亡叠加，让这位霸主的轮廓愈发模糊诡谲，未知叠加残暴，构筑出凌驾西陆所有势力的绝对威慑，让整片大陆的生灵皆活在其阴影笼罩之下。
苏野伫立侧方，全身骨骼肌群彻底锁死，无分毫松懈。眼眸死锁内陆废墟纵深，瞳孔凝缩成细窄黑线，视野切割所有断墙死角、废墟缝隙、雾流异动，全程高位戒备。他不信虚妄鬼神、不信无根传闻，只信绝对武力与硬核规则。能以单一势力碾压整片西陆、吞并所有武装聚落、制造无边废墟与无尽流民，足以证明对方手握完备体系与碾压战力，暗处每一缕风声、每一道影动，皆是潜在杀机，不容半分松懈。
林小满眉心褶皱僵硬固化，颅腔深处钝痛骤然加剧。整片疆域暴戾无序的紊乱能量疯狂穿刺、拉扯、磨损她的精神丝线，浓度与戾气远超海岸外围，杀戮、掠夺、绝望凝聚的负面气场层层堆叠、盘旋不散。她视野边缘灰翳持续蔓延，视物失真重影，单薄躯体不受控细碎震颤，呼吸浅促断续，只能凭极强意志力稳住感知网，硬扛精神过载的损耗，持续监测周遭潜藏的隐性异动。
“他的能力，是什么。”
难民抬眸望向内陆浓雾，眼底盛满死寂的恐惧，字句艰涩颤抖：“无解。”
“没人见过他全力出手。”
“所有见过他杀人的人，尽数死绝。”
“钢铁城出兵，无城不破、无势不摧、无人可逃。器械、人力、异能、地势，一切抵御皆为徒劳。”
他抬起干枯发黑、布满裂口痂皮的手掌，僵硬指向周遭绵延无尽的废墟滩涂：“这片海岸外围，原本坐落七座聚居城邦，有水源、有耕地、有壁垒，是流民拼死守住的唯一生存据点。半年之内，尽数被钢铁城踏平摧毁。”
“无投降余地、无归顺可能，持械者一律斩杀，青壮年一律掳掠奴役，老弱妇孺尽数驱逐出城，任由辐射侵蚀、饥饿耗竭、疾病吞噬，无人过问、无人施救、无人怜悯。”
“我们是最后一批逃出生天的人。”
空镜落定。
风滞。声寂。万物定格。
整片天地的死寂层层压实，胸腔窒息感、皮层发麻感、神经紧绷感同步堆叠，无一处可逃、无一刻可缓。
七座城邦彻底覆灭、千万人流离失所、整片疆域秩序清零，是钢铁城最冰冷的实力佐证。东大陆战乱有度，博弈存底线、征伐有尺度，格局落定便休战安民；西大陆的屠戮是彻底清零，不留生机、不留余地、不留未来，世间仅存臣服与消亡两种结局。
陆寻静默伫立，眼底死寂恒定，无丝毫情绪波动，只飞速复盘全局。西陆无休止的征伐、无底线的屠戮、无差别的掠夺，持续搅动全域能量暴走，辐射弥散、戾气淤积、秩序崩塌，失控的混沌能量跨海东侵，持续腐蚀原本安稳的东大陆，这便是天地失衡、祸源外泄的唯一根源。
这是西征的必然宿命。
不捣毁钢铁城、不终结独裁杀伐、不根治西陆无序祸源，东大陆的安稳永远是浮于表面的假象，所有平定的格局、重生的生机、民众的安宁，终将被持续外泄的混沌能量彻底吞噬、归零。
“钢铁城，驻扎地。”
难民躯体持续发颤，极速应答：“内陆中心，黑岩高地。地势最高，辐射最烈，戾气最盛。普通人三里之内，便会精神紊乱、皮层溃烂、脏器衰竭，无法存活。唯有钢铁城部众，可常年驻守死地。”
“他们不惧辐射，不惧戾气，不惧死地。”
“他们本身，即是死地。”
朴素短句，道尽西大陆全域生灵的极致绝望。钢铁城依托最凶险的辐射死地而生，以杀伐为存续根基，以混乱为滋养养分，是整片西陆无序、残酷、祸乱的终极源头。
陆寻微微颔首，所有情报脉络梳理完毕，清晰且冰冷。
黑岩高地，辐射核心，能量紊乱顶点，全域祸源盘踞之地。

Dead silence locked the entire tidal flat, the sea breeze completely stopped, the turbid air was caked and compacted, and pressed heavily on the cracked dark brown surface. The mixed and turbid smell of scorched radiation, moldy stagnant water, and old iron rot did not circulate at all. It stuck to the depths of the skin lines and damaged clothing. Every breath brought a dry and dull pain like tracheal frostbite. The eardrums continued to ring in the air at a low frequency, swallowing up all small movements, and the world became a cage of deathly silence with uniform grayscale. The hunched and stagnant figures of countless refugees, their empty eyes, and their withered and deformed bodies, completely blended with the crumbling and broken ruins, forming the background of the most primitive, cruel, and lifeless troubled times in the Western Continent. The words "Steel City" were settled, and there was no sound of wind or noise. Only the violent aura floating on the entire coast suddenly sank and sank. The invisible coercion penetrated the texture of the clothing, tightly tightened the chest and nerves, and gave birth to a continuous sense of physiological suffocation that made the skin and flesh tighten and the mind was chilling.
The middle-aged refugee stood stiffly with his head down, his body was broken and shaking. From the moment he uttered the name of Steel City, his breathing was forced to be shallow and restrained, and the rise and fall of his chest was deliberately suppressed to be extremely weak. In this death land completely shrouded by the shadow of power, mentioning the name of the overlord is taboo in itself. Years of massacres and eradication have made fear penetrate the flesh and take root in the bones and blood. It has become an instinctive stress reaction that requires no intimidation or reminder. Just a name is enough to crush the meager confidence left by the refugees at the bottom.
Lu Xun stood firmly on the beach with his feet, and the muscles in his shoulders and back were stiff and locked, leaving no room for relaxation. The gauze soaked in moisture in the palm of the hand was tight and hard, and the static air pressure continued to compress the wound. The long, dull pain continued to spread along the texture of the forearm, pulling repeatedly. The cross badge on the chest is burning at a low frequency, and the numb area of ​​the skin continues to expand, spreading from the chest to the neck and jaw. The surface skin continues to feel hot and heavy. This is the real physical feeling of facing the chaotic energy at the core of the disaster in the Western Continent at close range. His eyes were dark and without any light. He eliminated all distracting thoughts and stripped away all emotions. There was no sighing, no solemnity, and no waves. He only collected environmental information and deduced the direction of the situation with the most prudent survival attitude. He breathed evenly and coldly, and his constant rhythm was never disrupted by the dead and oppressive atmosphere around him.
He accurately captured all the exposed physiological flaws on the refugees: shoulders and necks contracted and tightened subconsciously, knees trembled uncontrollably, eyes were always lowered and dared not look straight, and breathing rhythms continued to be disordered and unbalanced. Every minor lapse is an instinctive reaction honed by long-term extreme fear, which intuitively proves that the brutality of Steel City is by no means false rumors, but an absolute deterrent that crushes the entire region and is deeply rooted in people's hearts. The power game in the Eastern Continent still has a bottom line, and there are standards and checks and balances for fighting and conquest. However, the order of the Western Continent has completely collapsed, and the primitive killing of the weak and the strong has become the only rule. Steel City is the ultimate controller of this set of cruel rules, with no bottom line, no checks and balances, and no room for leeway.
"City Lord, what's going on?"
The words are chopped up, short and cold, with no modifications, no words, and no emotional foreshadowing. They explode accurately in the dead air, piercing the static blank space. Pure evidence collection, no sympathy for suffering, no emotion for the troubled times, no sympathy, just to capture the core information that supports the decision-making on the way forward, all thoughts are in the service of survival and breaking the situation.
The middle-aged refugee's throat was repeatedly dry and rolling, and the damaged vocal cords were difficult to exert force. It took a long time to squeeze out a broken and hoarse voice: "No one knows... the real origin."
"Some people say that he is a remnant of the old era."
"Some people say that he is an alien born after radiation mutation."
"Some people say that he is the murderous evil that breeds in this rotten and dead land."
The three types of rumors are scattered and fragmented, with no way of verification, no historical records, and no personal evidence. They are all speculations and rumors spawned by extreme fear among low-class refugees in the endless slaughter and escape. Years of blood and tears, as well as countless deaths, have made the outline of this overlord increasingly blurry and strange. The unknown and cruelty have created an absolute deterrent that surpasses all forces in the Western Continent, and makes all living creatures in the entire continent live under its shadow.
Su Ye stood sideways, his skeletal muscles completely locked and not relaxed at all. His eyes were locked on the depth of the inland ruins, his pupils condensed into thin black lines, his field of vision cut through all the blind corners of broken walls, gaps in the ruins, and abnormal fog flows, and he was on high alert throughout the entire process. He does not believe in false ghosts, gods, or groundless rumors, but only in absolute force and hard-core rules. Being able to crush the entire Western Continent with a single force, annexing all armed settlements, creating boundless ruins and endless refugees, is enough to prove that the opponent has a complete system and crushing combat power. Every sound of wind and every movement in the dark is a potential murderous intention, and there is no room for relaxation.
The folds between Lin Xiaoman's brows became stiff and solidified, and the dull pain deep in his skull suddenly intensified. The violent and disorderly energy in the entire territory crazily pierced, pulled, and frayed her spiritual threads. The concentration and violence far exceeded the outer edges of the coast. The negative aura of killing, plundering, and despair was piled up and swirling. The gray haze at the edge of her vision continued to spread, her vision was distorted and ghosted, her thin body trembled uncontrollably, and her breathing was shallow and intermittent. She could only rely on her strong willpower to stabilize her sensory network, endure the wear and tear of mental overload, and continuously monitor the hidden changes in her surroundings.
"What is his ability?"
The refugee raised his eyes to look at the dense fog inland, his eyes filled with deathly fear, and his words were difficult and trembling: "No solution."
"No one has ever seen him take a full shot."
"Everyone who saw him kill people was killed."
"Steel City sends out troops. No city can be broken, no force cannot be destroyed, no one can escape. Equipment, manpower, supernatural powers, terrain, all resistance is in vain."
He raised his dry, blackened palms covered with cracks and scabs, and pointed stiffly at the endless stretches of ruined tidal flats around him: "On the periphery of this coast, there were originally seven inhabited city-states, with water sources, arable land, and barriers. They were the only survival strongholds that the refugees fought to hold on to. Within half a year, they were all crushed and destroyed by the Steel City."
"There is no room for surrender and no possibility of surrender. All armed people will be killed, all young and middle-aged people will be robbed and enslaved, and all the old, weak, women and children will be expelled from the city, leaving them to be corroded by radiation, exhausted by hunger, and devoured by disease. No one will care, no one will save them, and no one will show mercy."
"We were the last ones to escape."
The empty mirror settles.
Wind stagnation. Silence. Everything is fixed.
The dead silence of the entire world is compacted layer by layer. The feeling of suffocation in the chest, numbness of the cortex, and nervous tension are all stacked up at the same time. There is no place to escape and no moment to relax.
Seven city-states were completely destroyed, tens of millions of people were displaced, and the entire territory was cleared of order. This was the coldest evidence of the Iron City's strength. The war in the Eastern Continent is moderate, the bottom line of the game is maintained, and the conquests are measured. Once the pattern is settled, a truce is made to calm the people; the slaughter in the Western Continent is completely wiped out, leaving no vitality, no room, and no future. There are only two endings in the world: surrender and death.
Lu Xun stood silently, his eyes were deathly still, without the slightest emotion, and he could only quickly review the overall situation. The endless conquests, bottomless slaughter, and indiscriminate plunder in the Western Continent continue to stir up energy rampage in the entire region. Radiation is dispersed, hostility accumulates, and order collapses. The out-of-control chaotic energy invades eastward across the sea and continues to corrode the originally stable Eastern Continent. This is the only source of the imbalance between heaven and earth and the leakage of disasters.
This was the inevitable fate of the Western Expedition.
If the Iron City is not destroyed, the dictatorial killings are not ended, and the source of disorder in the Western Continent is not eradicated, the stability of the Eastern Continent will always be a superficial illusion. All the peaceful pattern, rebirth of vitality, and people's tranquility will eventually be completely swallowed up and reduced to zero by the chaotic energy that continues to leak out.
"Steel City, garrison."
The refugee's body continued to tremble and he responded quickly: "The center of the inland, the Black Rock Highlands. The terrain is the highest, the radiation is the most intense, and the hostility is the strongest. Within three miles, ordinary people will suffer from mental disorder, cortical ulceration, organ failure, and cannot survive. Only the Steel City tribe can garrison the death place all year round."
"They are not afraid of radiation, violence, and death."
"They themselves are the place of death."
A simple short sentence expresses the ultimate despair of all living beings in the Western Continent. The Steel City relied on the most dangerous radiation to survive, relied on killing as the basis for survival, and used chaos as nourishment. It was the ultimate source of disorder, cruelty, and chaos in the entire Western Continent.
Lu Xun nodded slightly, and all the information was sorted out, clear and cold.
Black Rock Plateau, the core of radiation, the apex of energy chaos, the place where the source of all disasters resides.
